paras: Upgrade your Honda Civic Type R or Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution's front braking performance with Dixcel brake pads, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel pads are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Honda Civic Type R (FK8) and Civic Type R (FL5) , along with the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution V and VI (CP9A) and the Lancer Evolution VII , VIII and IX (CT9A) . All of these vehicles share the same Brembo four piston front caliper , which is why a single pad shape suits both platforms. Multiple compound options are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the compound best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
